core_obligations: Reformulate condition (2) using the representable transformation attached to a morphism of schemes (proof lines 972-978).
Write the base change of Delta along (a, b) : h_T -> F x F as the top left corner of a diagram with two cartesian squares (proof lines 979-989).
Identify it as a base change of a morphism with property P and conclude (proof lines 990-994).
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for a presheaf F on (Sch/S)_{fppf} such that every fibre product h_U x_{a,F,b} h_V is representable by a scheme W and the induced morphism W -> U x_S V has a property P of the relative-representable-property type, the diagonal Delta : F -> F x F is representable and has property P (source lines 955-970). The proof reformulates condition (2) through the equivalence between the morphism h_U x_{a,F,b} h_V -> h_{U x_S V} and its representable counterpart, reads the base change of Delta along (a, b) : h_T -> F x F from a two-square commutative diagram both of whose squares are cartesian, and applies stability of P under base change.
